key_difference: (D) implements clearLocalData() as a bare d.set(nullptr) in the header, so it can re-create thread-local storage during shutdown; (B) adds QThreadStorageData::clear(), which first checks QThreadData::currentThreadData(), making clearLocalData() unconditionally shutdown-safe. Because of this, (D) has to keep the external guard and the private qthread_p.h include in qcollator.cpp, and its QFontCache::cleanup() change calls clearLocalData() with no guard at all.
